subject: Password reset request
body: One employee forgot their password and needs a reset. Other users can sign in normally.

subject: Billing invoice copy
body: Please send a copy of last month's invoice. There is no service interruption.

subject: Single user cannot login
body: One employee receives an invalid-session error when logging in. Other employees can access the system.

subject: Payment retry needed
body: One customer's card payment failed twice, but other payments are processing successfully.

subject: Dashboard slow for one team
body: A five-person analytics team reports dashboard pages taking 20 seconds to load; other departments are normal.

subject: Checkout failures affecting many customers
body: A large number of customers cannot complete checkout. Some transactions still succeed, but revenue is being affected.

subject: Authentication outage for department
body: Most employees in the finance department cannot log in, blocking their normal work.

subject: Major performance degradation
body: The customer portal is extremely slow for users across multiple regions, although it remains reachable.

subject: Payment platform completely unavailable
body: No customers can process payments in production. All checkout transactions are failing and revenue is immediately impacted.

subject: Company-wide authentication outage
body: All employees and customers are unable to sign in to the production platform.
